title: AshaVisitRecord
description: Versioned v1 structured ASHA home-visit record. Unknown or unprovided values MUST be represented as null rather than guessed. A record with status='draft' is unconfirmed and MUST NOT be treated as durably saved until status='committed' with a persistence_record_id acknowledged by the persistence layer.

visit_id.description: Unique identifier for this visit draft/record generated by Agent 1.

beneficiary_id.description: Resolved synthetic beneficiary identifier from the beneficiary directory, or null if unresolved/ambiguous.

beneficiary_name.description: Synthetic beneficiary display name resolved from the directory, or null if unresolved.

visit_type.description: Standardised ASHA home-visit category, or null if not yet stated.

weight_kg.description: Measured weight in kilograms (newborn or maternal), or null if unprovided.

weight_source_text.description: Short extracted phrase from which weight_kg was parsed (e.g., '2.8 kilo'), or null.

vaccinations_completed.description: Vaccinations reported as already completed during or prior to this visit.

vaccinations_due.description: Vaccinations reported as due or pending for the beneficiary.

next_visit_date.description: ISO-8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) in Asia/Kolkata timezone for the scheduled next visit, or null.

next_visit_date_source_text.description: Short extracted date phrase from which next_visit_date was resolved (e.g., 'agle mangalwar'), or null.

danger_signs.description: Canonical danger-sign identifiers detected during this visit session.

danger_sign_flagged.description: True if any verified danger sign was detected at any point during the visit; preserved even if the workflow continues.

follow_up_actions.description: Structured follow-up actions derived from danger-sign escalation, pending vaccinations, or scheduled next visits.

status.description: Lifecycle state: 'draft' (unconfirmed working state), 'confirmed' (explicitly confirmed by ASHA worker after read-back, awaiting persistence), 'committed' (durably saved and acknowledged by Agent 3 persistence layer).

confirmed_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when the ASHA worker explicitly confirmed the read-back, or null while in draft.

committed_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when Agent 3 confirmed durable persistence, or null until committed.

persistence_record_id.description: Opaque durable record identifier returned by Agent 3's persistence layer upon commit, or null until committed.

language.description: Active BCP-47 language tag (e.g., hi-IN, kn-IN, ta-IN, en-IN) or 'indic-auto'.

timezone.description: Calendar timezone policy used to resolve relative dates such as next_visit_date and follow-up due_date.

synthetic.description: True for all demonstration and test records using synthetic beneficiaries.

observations.description: Extensible list of dynamically captured observations/measurements (weight, height, feeding, temperature, BP, notes, etc.) with source provenance and confirmation status.

events.description: Repeatable structured visit events (immunisations, counselling, referrals, checkups) where multiple items of the same type are tracked individually.

action_type.description: Machine-readable category for the follow-up action.

description.description: Concise human-readable action description for the ASHA worker or supervisor dashboard.

due_date.description: ISO-8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD, Asia/Kolkata) when the action is due, or null for immediate/unspecified.

priority.description: Action priority; danger-sign PHC referrals MUST use 'urgent'.

source_phrase.description: Short utterance phrase or rule basis that generated this action, or null.

follow_up_actions.description: Schedule Td-2 vaccination at next VHND session
